p1: A serial killer mailed this code to a newspaper. It took 51 years to read it.
Then letters arrived at newspapers. Signed with a crosshair.
He called himself the Zodiac. He claimed 37 victims.
November 1969. He sent the San Francisco Chronicle 340 symbols.
Nobody could read it. Until December 2020.
Three amateur codebreakers. In America, Australia and Belgium.
They cracked it. The FBI confirmed it.
It begins: I hope you are having lots of fun in trying to catch me.
Then: I am not afraid of the gas chamber... because I now have enough slaves to work for me.
The Zodiac was never caught. Never identified.
And one of his ciphers is still unsolved. 13 symbols. After the words... My name is.
